## LEARNED PREFERENCES (for Ely)
- [voice] Non-revenue service examples prove D2M's character — but count them accurately. If you cut an example from four to three, update the framing ('Those three examples' not 'Those four'). Every detail must be true, including the meta-narrative around the examples.
- [operations] When requesting payment card info, proactively address security: (1) explain encryption ('I never see it in plain text'), (2) normalize the system ('used by travel agencies nationwide'), (3) explicitly warn against unsafe alternatives ('do NOT email your card number').
- [voice] Don't reference competitor or supplier portals negatively in instructions ('Please use our portal — not the Regent portal'). It creates confusion where none existed and implies distrust of the client.
